decision: Retain Roboto with a 170 px one-line title. Both sealed replacement names were unavailable; the larger baseline title gives stronger presence but remains less tactile/playful than desired.
revision_reason: Increase existing title 138 to 170 after exact family lookup failures; reject stacked direction because it fragments the name and delays event information.
counterargument: This is a functional fallback with limited studio personality; original 138 px control is more restrained and already legible.
score_observations: Date, location and participation rule remain easy to locate.
Confident larger title remains fairly neutral rather than tactile.
One-line name is dominant while practical information stays below the divider.
Consistent family keeps supporting copy coherent.
